% =====================================================================
%  TEMPLATE-main.tex
%  Starting point for a new course book. Copy it, do not edit it:
%
%      cp .shared/TEMPLATE-main.tex "NEW COURSE/main.tex"
%
%  Work down the file. Fill in every REQUIRED block, delete every
%  OPTIONAL block you do not use. A short main.tex is the goal --- the
%  shared preamble in .shared/utpnotes.tex owns everything the eight
%  existing books have in common, and section numbers below refer to
%  its table of contents.
%
%  Build from inside the course folder; the paths here are relative:
%
%      cd "NEW COURSE" && pdflatex main.tex   (three times)
% =====================================================================
\documentclass[11pt,oneside,a4paper]{report}

% ---------- course configuration ----------
% REQUIRED. The running head, the lab count in the "Lab 3 of N"
% banners, and the cover text. See section 1 of utpnotes.tex for the
% rest of the knobs, including \utpauthor and \utpextragraphicspath.
\def\utprunninghead{New Course Notes}
\def\utplabtotal{8}
\def\utpcoursetitle{New Course}
\def\utpcourseoutline{%
  One or two lines on what the book covers. A \ breaks the line.%
}

% OPTIONAL. A book with no \part divisions.
% \def\utpstyleparts{0}
%
% OPTIONAL. A book whose chapters are each a lab, so the badge and the
% contents say Lab rather than Chapter.
% \def\utpchapterlabel{LAB}
% \def\utpchaptertocword{Lab~}
% \def\utpchaptertocindent{0em}
% \def\utpchaptertocnumwidth{5.3em}
%
% OPTIONAL. An image folder of your own, searched before .shared/.
% \def\utpextragraphicspath{{assets/}}
%
% OPTIONAL. Rename a box without restating its geometry. The full list
% of titles is in section 8 of utpnotes.tex.
% \def\utptitlepitfall{Technical note}
% \def\utptitlelabmode{How the practical connects to the concept}

% ---------- everything shared with the other courses ----------
% REQUIRED, and everything below it is an override of what it sets.
\input{../.shared/utpnotes}

% ---------- packages only this book needs ----------
% OPTIONAL. The shared set is the union of what the books use; add
% here only what is genuinely yours.
% \usepackage[linesnumbered,ruled,vlined]{algorithm2e}

% ---------- boxes this book styles differently ----------
% OPTIONAL. Prefer the named hooks over a hand-written \renewtcolorbox:
% \utpbreakableframes             figure and table frames may split
% \utpheavycallouts               solid title bars, firmer frames
% \utplabprojectcolour{UTPNavy}   the lab banner in another colour
%
% Anything else is a \renewtcolorbox naming the box you want to change:
% \renewtcolorbox{keyidea}{...}

% ---------- boxes used only in this book ----------
% OPTIONAL. Declare them with the shared constructors so they match the
% others; a trailing key list overrides any of the house geometry. If a
% second book ever wants one, move it to section 8 of utpnotes.tex.
% \utpnewcallout{mybox}{UTPPaleBlue}{UTPBlue}{Something to act on}
% \utpnewquietbox{myaside}{UTPMuted!55}{UTPMuted}{Something to read past}

% ---------- other settings used only in this book ----------
% OPTIONAL. A listing style built on a shared base, the TikZ diagram
% vocabulary under your own prefix, a captioned-figure alias, and the
% default style for \begin{lstlisting}.
% \lstdefinestyle{abccode}{style=utpcode,language=Python}
% \lstdefinestyle{abcterminal}{style=utpterminal}
% \lstset{style=abccode}
% \utpdiagramstyles{abc}{1.0cm}{0.8cm}
% \utpfigalias{abcfig}
%
% Pseudocode, if the book sets any:
% \usepackage[linesnumbered,ruled,vlined]{algorithm2e}
% \utpalgorithmstyle

% ---------- the book ----------
\begin{document}
% \utpfrontmatter prints the cover, the contents, and the overview
% chapter named by \utpcoursemap (chapters/course-map by default; set
% \def\utpcoursemap{} if the book has none), then starts page 1.
\utpfrontmatter

% REQUIRED. One \input per chapter, in reading order. \part divisions
% are optional; drop them and set \utpstyleparts to 0 if unused.
\part{First Stage}
\input{chapters/01-first-chapter}

% OPTIONAL. Appendices, with contents entries reading "Appendix A".
% \appendix
% \renewcommand{\cftchappresnum}{Appendix~}
% \input{appendices/reference}

\end{document}
